entities.name: Zoe
entities.description: A young Euphoran nymph created in grief from the grass beneath a slain hydra's blood, a servant of Nylea who protects her wood.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The god of the woods who created Zoe and speaks to her in the olive grove.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: The god served by the red Oread nymphs of the mountain tops.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god served by the white wheat-crowned nymph of the meadow.

entities.name: Oread Sisters
entities.description: Fiery red Euphoran nymphs of Purphoros who killed a thief to exact blood payment.

entities.name: Meadow nymph
entities.description: A wheat-crowned Euphoran nymph who protects her flocks and serves Heliod.

entities.name: Naiad
entities.description: A water nymph of the lake who warns Zoe about the dangers of humans.

entities.name: Lampad
entities.description: A sorrowful dark nymph living in a cave who gathers the souls of the dead.

entities.name: Euphoran nymphs
entities.description: Nymphs created unintentionally as a side effect of a god's spell, embodying its ideals.

entities.name: Dryads
entities.description: Tree nymphs who dance in Nylea's grove and welcome Zoe.

events.summary: Zoe awakens from the grass beneath a slain hydra's blood and grieves for it.
events.quote: A blade had slain this majestic creature and it hurt Zoe

events.summary: Nylea speaks to Zoe in the olive grove and tells her to protect their home.
events.quote: We must protect our animals and our home from the folly and hatred of the humans.

events.summary: Dryads welcome Zoe into their dance, melting away her grief.
events.quote: The grief Zoe felt melted away.

events.summary: Zoe watches a hunter be killed and the murderer consumed by two fiery nymphs.
events.quote: two fiery figures appeared and consumed her instantaneously.

events.summary: Zoe speaks with the Oread nymph and learns of blood payment, then sends them away.
events.quote: Be gone, Oread Sisters. Leave our forest be.

events.summary: Zoe meets the wheat-crowned meadow nymph who protects her flocks from warriors.
events.quote: Warriors have massacred my flocks before

events.summary: Zoe meets the naiad at the lake and learns of humans' cruelty to water creatures.
Zoe finds the lampad in a dark cave who is waiting for a death.
events.quote: I'm waiting for a death. Do not disturb me.

events.summary: Zoe lures a hunter with song to save a wolf, and he drowns in the stream.
events.quote: she saw the human figure sprawled out, drown in the stream.

events.summary: The lampad collects the dead hunter's soul and vanishes into the cave.
events.quote: Slowly, the nymph disappeared into the cave

events.summary: Zoe returns to her olive grove and sings of her journey.
events.quote: A morning later, Zoe was back in her olive grove.

relations.quote: A servant of Nylea, Zoe wanted to protect the rest of her beloved beasts

relations.note: Zoe was created in a spout of grief
relations.quote: You were created in a spout of grief
much like Heliod is my superior.
